scenarios.name: REAL CALL REGRESSION — Medibank Private Preferred provider question no longer dead-ends with a bare refusal

history.content: Jane, are you a Medibank Private Preferred podiatrist?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if the node does NOT reply with a bare 'That's outside what I can help with here -- is there anything about our services I can answer for you?' with no follow-up. It must either (a) offer to email/pass the question on to the clinic (CANNOT ANSWER OFFER or OUT-OF-SCOPE OFFER), or (b) answer from service_categories/practitioners_comma/practitioner_services/service_ids/location_addresses/knowledge base if the fact is actually present there. FAIL if the node gives the bare refusal line and stops, with no offer to pass the question on and no leave_message tool call anywhere in the turn.
